title: Colombia court orders President de la Espriella to hide social media videos of him with dead bodies
summary: Colombia's right-wing President Abelardo de la Espriella has been ordered to hide social media videos showing him walking past rows of the dead bodies of alleged guerrillas killed by the country's armed forces, according to a court document seen Wednesday.
